audit_title: Dated Vendor OHLCV Coverage and Session Outage Audit

history_requirement_policy.description: Strict preservation of representation and feature warmup windows without relaxing history requirements
history_requirement_policy.relaxation_policy: NO_RELAXATION (strict adherence to causal, uninterrupted data integrity)

China.root_cause: Vendor OHLCV daily parquet files omit two consecutive scheduled trading sessions in April 2019

outage_periods.reason: 503-session continuous history window required; 2019-04-30 gap contaminates all evaluation input windows through 2021-05-27

fold_admissibility.2020: ZERO_ADMISSIBLE (legitimately excluded by 503-session history rule; INVALID_BAR_IN_INPUT_WINDOW)
fold_admissibility.2021: PARTIAL_ADMISSIBLE (excluded through 2021-05-27; fully admissible from 2021-05-28 through 2021-12-31)

India.root_cause: Vendor OHLCV daily parquets omit early 2019 scheduled sessions (2019-02-13, 2019-03-29) and a special Saturday disaster-recovery trading session (2024-01-20)

outage_periods.reason: 503-session continuous history window required; 2019-03-29 gap contaminates evaluation input windows through 2021-04-19
Missing Saturday disaster-recovery session (2024-01-20) present in venue calendar but missing in vendor parquets invalidates subsequent 503 sessions across 2024 and 2025

fold_admissibility.2020: ZERO_ADMISSIBLE (legitimately excluded by 503-session history rule; INVALID_BAR_IN_INPUT_WINDOW)
fold_admissibility.2021: PARTIAL_ADMISSIBLE (excluded through 2021-04-19; fully admissible from 2021-04-20 through 2021-12-31)
fold_admissibility.2024: ZERO_ADMISSIBLE (legitimately excluded by 2024-01-20 missing Saturday session under strict history rule)
fold_admissibility.2025: ZERO_ADMISSIBLE (legitimately excluded by 2024-01-20 missing Saturday session under strict history rule)
